title: OpenPGP: SW 0x6C (wrong Le) not handled, PIV handles it
description: ISO 7816-4 SW1=0x6C means 'wrong Le, retry with Le=SW2'. wp11_proto_piv.c handles this correctly (lines 572-580). wp11_proto_openpgp.c does not -- it returns WP11_OPENPGP_ERR_SW on 0x6C responses. Compliant OpenPGP tokens may send 0x6C during sign/authenticate/get_ard, causing spurious failures.
